source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API · ECMWF/Copernicus ERA5
interpretation: Near-surface model estimates: temperature at 2 m and wind at 10 m above ground. Precipitation is the preceding-hour rain/snow water-equivalent total. Not measurements at bird flight altitude.
selection: 1° nodes bordering retained fixes and short, interpolated segments; no complete continental field. Nearest grid cell, including ocean; elevation downscaling disabled.
